'''2007 Oklahoma State Championship Jacob Mayer LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jacob Mayer]] at [[2007 Oklahoma State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' Jake Mayer
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
